verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists, but the evidence only shows a 30-day money-back guarantee, change-of-address guidance and AI summaries listed there. Product pages describe scans as "free" and forwarding as "discounted rates included" without giving any figures. missing for 10: monthly plan prices, explicit scan allowances per plan, per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage and check deposit, and any independent confirmation that pricing is complete.
